threshold_rule: D-only smallest integer count with <=1% hits; >=2 active; no forced top1
sampling_unit: V eligible positions; original documents UNKNOWN
random_examples: uniform hash-ranked hit contexts; hash-ranked hit position within each selected context
high_examples: largest member count within each distinct context, then smallest position ID; ratio score=count/group size
bootstrap_independence: conditional on contiguous block independence, not document-valid
